title: evcc: add envsubst secret support
reason: Real new mkOption 'environmentFile' added, matching the coordinator's flagged title exactly, plus a real package option added and real systemd hardening reordering.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: NEW STRUCTURAL GAP -- THIRD CONFIRMED INSTANCE OF A RECURRING SHAPE THIS ROUND: total non-discovery, both sides, 0 discovered_options. Root cause: the module declares `options.services.evcc = with lib.types; { ... };` -- the options attrset is wrapped directly in a `with <namespace>; {...}` expression rather than being a bare attrset literal. This is the SAME general shape as batch8's nvidia-container-toolkit `options = let ... in {...}` gap (a non-literal wrapper immediately around the options value), just using `with` instead of `let...in`. Confirmed as a real, reproducible pattern this batch: also seen at frigate (433539, this same batch) and consistent again at nvidia-container-toolkit (398993/480839, this same batch). Naming this candidate_capability_gap: options-value-wrapped-in-non-literal-expression (with/let) causes total non-discovery -- now a well-characterized, recurring shape with 4+ instances across 2 batches, not a one-off.
